comparison.objective: Fasten a bracket bolt using a ratchet in confined access; candidate adjusts and secures switch mounts.
comparison.physical_skill: Ratchet socket engagement, restricted-arc regrasping, and bolt tightening versus screwdriver alignment, partial release, sensor sliding, holding, and retightening.
comparison.success_condition: Bolt must reach the specified seated/tightened state without tool slip or damage; candidate requires two ≤6 mm over-center registrations retained 3 seconds.
comparison.reason: Confined fastening alone does not duplicate the candidate’s adjustment-feedback loop. Candidate screw torque, strip threshold, and allowable registration drift are unspecified.
